reason: A DSH Web client plugin that provides four selectable visual skins using theme tokens, optional embedded background images, and a settings-page skin selector.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供可在设置中选择的 Nord、极光、纸张和云梦等视觉皮肤。
summaries.en: Provides selectable visual skins for the DSH Web GUI, including Nord, Aurora, Paper, and Dream themes.

capabilities: Registers client-side themes for the DSH Web GUI
Adds a skin selector to the general settings area
Applies theme tokens and scoped background styles in the document
Embeds background images as data URLs in the client bundle
Persists the selected theme through the host theme preference
